title: Case M — TPU Atsugi campus
summary: Tracer-gas release on the Tokyo Polytechnic University Atsugi campus: 1:600 tunnel (velocity at 180°, ethylene concentration at 175°, 180° and 185°) and 18 field runs with PMCH, 15 points 3 m above ground.

configuration.site: Tokyo Polytechnic University, Atsugi campus; terrain falls from about 32 m (campus plateau) to 3.6 m at the east edge; tallest building about 32 m
configuration.measurement_height_note: 3 m above the local ground, full scale (0.005 m model)
configuration.field_wind_directions_deg: 78 ... 200.7 (mean direction at the reference point per run); 11 of 18 within 5° of 180°

reference.R: rooftop of the main building: the point is 41 m above the ground, 8 m above the roof in the STL

tracer.tunnel: C2H4, 100 %, 6 mm outlet, 150 cc/min = 2.5e-6 m3/s (0.09 m/s)
tracer.field: PMCH (C7F14), 200 ppm, 5 L/min, 1.5 m above ground, 25-26 Feb 2014, 18 runs of 10 min sampling

configuration.normalisation: concentration ratio = C / c0, c0 = q / (U_R H_R^2): 132.5 ppm in the tunnel (the paper rounds to 1.33e2); per run in the field (1,444 ... 7,379 ppq)
configuration.instrument: tunnel: DANTEC split-fibre probe (1000 Hz, 240 s) and high-speed hydrocarbon analyser; field: sorbent tubes with GC-ECD, sonic anemometer SAT-600 at the reference point
configuration.tunnel: Eiffel-type boundary-layer wind tunnel, Tokyo Polytechnic University; cross-section 1.0 m high, 1.2 m wide; power law exponent 0.27 (AIJ Loads category IV) with an upwind taper for the topography

frame.origin: centre of the tunnel turntable on the floor plane (ground surface there at z = 33.07 m)
frame.y: +y WEST (compass rose of MP_caseM.png: N at +x, W at +y); the frame is right-handed
frame.z: +z up from the TUNNEL FLOOR; the campus ground lies at z ~ 32 m
frame.wind_direction_rotation: meteorological FROM-direction, so 180° blows toward +x; flow_dir = (-cos WD, +sin WD), and a larger WD turns the plume toward -y. Measured on the tunnel's 175 / 180 / 185° and on the 18 field runs.

inflow_fit.method: power law on the workbook's 40 heights (z 0.005 ... 0.6 m model) at x = -0.498 m; the data paper states exponent 0.27
inflow_fit.note: z is height above the empty tunnel floor; at the profile station the model's taper is already 0.052 m high, so the 10 lowest heights lie below it

known_issues: Field concentrations are in ppq (1e-15 volume fraction) and the tunnel's in ppm: 1 ppq = 1e-9 ppm. The cleaned table converts the field's to ppm and carries C / c0 for both, with the run's own c0 in the field.
Every field run has its own reference speed U_R, mean direction WD_R and tracer flow q (clean/manifest.json -> cases.M.extra_measurements.field_runs); the row's wind_direction_deg is WD_R.
The tunnel measured velocity only at 180°; at 175° and 185° the CSV has -999.9 in all seven velocity columns.

RS-WT_caseM.csv is the legacy workbook rounded (2 dp velocity, 1 dp concentration), and its k is half the sum of the 2-dp RMS values, up to 0.005 m2/s2 from the workbook's; the cleaned table carries the workbook's values.
The tunnel source is on the ground in the workbook, LC_caseM.csv and the STL (readme: 'on a rooftop'); the field source was 1.5 m above ground.
H_R = 41 m is the anemometer height above the ground; the main roof under the reference point is about 33 m above it. c0 uses H_R = 0.068 m (41 m / 600 = 0.06833 m would give 131.2 ppm, -1 %).
The field has an ambient floor of 8 - 11 ppq at points 11 - 15 in every run (not subtracted); the tunnel's concentration has a zero offset (two negative means at point 12) and an rms floor of 7 ppm.
Only 11 of the 18 field runs are within 5° of 180°, the tunnel's direction; runs 1, 2 and 9 have U_R of 1.4 - 1.8 m/s.

BD_caseM.stl is MODEL scale, wound inward on its ground and roof facets, and has 21 boundary and 7 non-manifold edges (7 on the rim of the panel, 14 on 7 slivers hanging on building roofs); the served geometry.stl is multiplied by 600, re-wound outward, without the slivers and closed with a base slab down to z = -1 m.
The approach-flow heights are above the empty tunnel floor: at the profile station the model's taper is 0.052 m high, above the 10 lowest profile heights.
